'''Treegin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He worked at a [[Forard research station|research station]] that was located near to the town [[Forard]], serving as the head of the station's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] division.
